travel_have_experience_with.question: Do you have experience with travel & hospitality SEO?
travel_have_experience_with.answer: Yes. AVR Web Consulting has run SEO and AI visibility programmes for travel & hospitality businesses across India, the USA, UK, UAE and Europe. We work to leisure and business travellers planning itineraries search behaviour and a typical 3–90 days decision cycle rather than applying a generic checklist.

travel_long_travel_amp.question: How long does travel & hospitality SEO take to show results?
travel_long_travel_amp.answer: Technical and on-page fixes usually move impressions within 3–6 weeks. Meaningful ranking and enquiry growth typically lands in months 3–6, with compounding gains after that. Sites with existing authority move faster than new domains.

travel_travel_amp_hospitality.question: What does travel & hospitality SEO cost at AVR Web Consulting?
travel_travel_amp_hospitality.answer: Programmes start at $100/month for focused local or single-service work and scale with content volume, number of locations and competition. We quote after an initial audit so the scope matches the opportunity, not a template.

travel_which_keywords_matter.question: Which keywords matter most for travel & hospitality?
travel_which_keywords_matter.answer: The highest-value clusters are destination and itinerary planning queries; "best time to visit" and cost questions; hotel and package comparisons. We prioritise commercial intent first, then supporting informational content that feeds both search rankings and AI answers.

travel_get_travel_amp.question: How do you get travel & hospitality brands mentioned by ChatGPT and Perplexity?
travel_get_travel_amp.answer: AI trip planners assemble itineraries from structured, specific sources. Publishing real day-by-day detail with prices makes your content the raw material.

travel_structured_data_implement.question: What structured data do you implement for travel & hospitality?
travel_structured_data_implement.answer: We deploy Hotel + TouristTrip + Offer alongside sitewide Organization and BreadcrumbList markup, validated against Google's Rich Results Test and kept in sync as content changes.

travel_also_handle_paid.question: Do you also handle paid ads for travel & hospitality clients?
travel_also_handle_paid.answer: Yes. Google Ads and social advertising run alongside SEO so you have demand today while organic and AI visibility compound. Many clients start with paid for speed and shift budget to organic as rankings mature.

travel_which_kpis_report.question: Which KPIs do you report for travel & hospitality?
travel_which_kpis_report.answer: We report direct bookings from organic, destination cluster rankings, map-pack visibility per property, ai planner citations — plus AI visibility tracking that shows how often your brand appears in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.

travel_work_manual_safe.question: Is the work manual and safe for travel & hospitality sites?
travel_work_manual_safe.answer: Every link, citation and content asset is produced manually. We use no PBNs, no automated link tools and no AI-spun content — critical in a sector where otas outrank operators for their own inventory.

travel_work_with_our.question: Can you work with our existing travel & hospitality website?
travel_work_with_our.answer: Yes. We audit and improve what you have first — most sites gain more from fixing crawlability, structure and content depth than from a rebuild. If a rebuild genuinely pays back, our web team can handle it.
